stories.title: Amazon cargo plane overruns runway at Miami airport, killing 5
stories.reason: The Prime Air-operated Boeing 767 was traveling nearly 130 mph when it left the runway and slammed into ground vehicles; the pilots hadn't declared an emergency, and the FAA and NTSB are now investigating.

stories.title: Israeli strikes kill at least 11 in a southern Lebanon village, including two children
stories.reason: The strikes on Kfar Rumman, including a drone strike that killed two medics in their car, came without an evacuation warning and mark a sharp escalation despite a ceasefire with Hezbollah reached more than two months ago.

stories.title: Iran vows a 'more painful' response as Hormuz traffic collapses and gas prices hit a Labor Day record
stories.reason: Only about four commodity vessels crossed the Strait of Hormuz on a recent day versus a normal 15, while US retail diesel hit a record $5.85 a gallon as the parliament speaker threatens a 'faster, more intense' reply to US strikes.

stories.title: Global bond yields hit multi-decade highs in Japan, Germany and France
stories.reason: Japan's 10-year yield broke 3% for the first time since 1996 and French and German yields hit levels last seen in 2008 and 2011, as oil-driven inflation fears challenge the assumption that economies can absorb higher-for-longer rates.

stories.title: FluidStack raises $1.5 billion at an $18 billion valuation to build AI data centers
stories.reason: The startup, which owns no chips itself, more than doubled its valuation in months by building the data centers that will house a customer's 1 million Google TPUs, illustrating how lucrative AI infrastructure has become even for non-chip players.

stories.title: LG Electronics shares jump 8% on plans for a Bear Robotics Nasdaq listing
stories.reason: LG's majority-owned robotics unit is seeking a pre-IPO round at a roughly $1.5 billion valuation ahead of a planned US listing, part of a broader investor rush into physical AI and robotics.

stories.title: LAUSD becomes the second major US school district to restrict student AI use
stories.reason: Los Angeles Unified is blocking generative AI on school-issued devices for all students while a new committee develops guardrails, following New York City's similar moratorium days earlier.

stories.title: Hurricane Lowell to pass near Kauai as a major hurricane, prompting tropical storm warnings
stories.reason: Lowell is expected to pass just west of Kauai and Niihau late Monday with gusts up to 74 mph and waves as high as 14 feet, marking Hawaii's third major storm threat in three weeks.
